extracted.intended_audience: prospective domain buyers, entrepreneurs launching a news & media business, and brand/acquisition purchasers
extracted.subtask_description: A marketplace listing for purchasing the domain API.media, describing price, payment options, transfer process, protections, and support for buyers looking to acquire a domain for a news/media business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verified Domain / Seller ownership confirmed
rubrics_metrics.description: Seller ownership has been confirmed. This domain is available and ready to transfer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the listing has verification that the seller controls the domain, reducing risk of fraudulent listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure Transactions (escrow protection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Atom holds your payment until the domain is in your account; funds are released to the seller only after successful delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment is protected until transfer completion; the transfer is guaranteed per the marketplace's process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fast Domain Transfers
rubrics_metrics.description: The marketplace manages the transfer process from start to finish. Most domains change hands within hours of purchase, many in under 1 hour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an expectation for turnaround time and that the platform handles transfer logistics on behalf of buyer and seller.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible Payments / Installment options
rubrics_metrics.description: Pay in full by credit card, crypto or wire transfer, or break your purchase into installments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example installment plan shown: USD $660 × 12 months + $800 down payment. Buyers can pay off balance anytime or cancel at any time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate use after initial payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Start using your domain immediately after your first payment; full ownership transfers once all payments are complete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows operational use of the domain before final transfer on installment plans; clarifies timing of ownership transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purchase Protection Program / Refund guarantee
rubrics_metrics.description: 100% refund guaranteed if domain can't be transferred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marketplace offers a refund protection policy; paired with payment protection until transfer completes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent pricing & purchase actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing shows Buy Now price (USD $7,999), installment pricing, options to Make an Offer, and Track Price.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Buyers can purchase at listed price, propose alternative offers, or receive notifications if price changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer support & responsiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact options provided (phone and email) with advertised replies in ~3 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assures availability of live assistance during purchase/transfer process; useful for resolving issues quickly.
